title: Dimension X

Early Belgian Quake/Quakeworld clan.

== History ==
'''Dimension X''' was founded as a Quakeworld clan in [[1997]]. For its lifespan as a QW clan (it still exists in 2008 as a Q3 clan), '''DX''' was exlusively a LAN clan.
